# Human Super Intelligence (HSI)

> Biomedical research and translational intelligence: connect biological knowledge and scientific evidence to investigate unresolved questions and inform the next research decision. Research intelligence under development — not a clinical decision system and not a substitute for qualified professional care.

Canonical site: https://www.humansuperintelligence.tech/
Sitemap: https://www.humansuperintelligence.tech/sitemap.xml
Robots: https://www.humansuperintelligence.tech/robots.txt

## Public marketing pages

- [Home](https://www.humansuperintelligence.tech/): Connected biology and scientific knowledge overview
- [Platform](https://www.humansuperintelligence.tech/platform): Unified research workflow — investigate, connect, evaluate, translate, decide
- [Research Intelligence](https://www.humansuperintelligence.tech/research): Beyond literature search toward investigation
- [Explore Biology](https://www.humansuperintelligence.tech/biology): Multi-scale biological intelligence
- [Drug Discovery](https://www.humansuperintelligence.tech/drug-discovery): Mechanism-to-target intelligence (not a de novo design engine)
- [Applications](https://www.humansuperintelligence.tech/solutions): Cross-domain research applications
- [Science](https://www.humansuperintelligence.tech/science): Educational biology and evidence explorer
- [Technology](https://www.humansuperintelligence.tech/technology): Knowledge graph, agents, governance, experience
- [Science & Trust](https://www.humansuperintelligence.tech/evidence-safety): Scientific principles and validation honesty
- [Research Outcomes](https://www.humansuperintelligence.tech/how-it-works): Dossiers, assessments and research briefs
- [About](https://www.humansuperintelligence.tech/about): Mission and collaboration interest
- [Collaborate](https://www.humansuperintelligence.tech/contact): Research access and collaboration
- [Access options](https://www.humansuperintelligence.tech/pricing): Research access paths

## Brand

Public brand is **Human Super Intelligence (HSI) only**. Legacy catalogue URLs for separate product brands redirect into HSI platform/biology/applications pages.

## Honesty / non-goals

- No live clinical decision support (CDS) and no patient PHI in the HSI substrate
- Gate C / scientific promotion to product knowledge graphs remains human-gated
- Account signup does not grant research write or reviewer permissions
- No fabricated metrics, testimonials, logos or scientific results
- APIs under `/api/` and internal `/_pages/` HTML are not public discovery surfaces
